title: Decoding Safety Feedback from Diverse Raters: A Data-driven Lens on Responsiveness to Severity
findings: Raters who consider religion important tend to give higher toxicity scores for text comments. However, their ratings show lower alignment (measured by Monotonic Precision Area, MPA) with the collective judgment of the crowd, indicating that their perception of severity variations differs from the broader group.
